title: Onboarding readiness
viewPurpose: Check whether required runtime resources and executor role assignments are present before FDAI can operate.
notConfigured: The Azure onboarding probe is not configured. These gaps describe the required baseline, not observed tenant state.
probeFailed: The configured Azure onboarding probe failed. No tenant readiness observation is available.
missingRoleCaption: Role assignments missing from the latest onboarding readiness observation
requiredRoleCaption: Role assignments required by the onboarding baseline
sourceSampleDescription: Sample mode uses deterministic fixtures. It runs no probe and grants no access.
sourceObservedDescription: Values come from the configured Operator API onboarding probe. Readiness evidence grants no access or execution authority.
sourceBaselineDescription: The repository baseline is shown because no authoritative tenant observation is available. It does not prove that resources or roles are missing.
